verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-015 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-015: administrative recovery override is an exceptional flow with enhanced audit
quotes: assert len(rows) == 1, f"{label}: expected exactly one {action.value} audit, saw {len(rows)}"
verdicts.why: The check requires administrator authorization and exactly one recovery-override audit. It does not assert enhanced audit data such as actor provenance or other exceptional-flow metadata.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-006 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
verdicts.why: The check detects that a suspended staff account cannot authenticate and that its existing session no longer resolves. It does not test service principals or their credentials, and does not directly attempt authentication or session resolution after the account becomes disabled.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-051 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-051: every action in the audit catalog writes exactly one AuditRecord with actor provenance; service actors record key_version
quotes: assert len(rows) == 1, f"{label}: expected exactly one {action.value} audit, saw {len(rows)}"
verdicts.why: Selected staff actions are checked for exactly one audit record. Actor provenance is not asserted, service actors and key_version are not tested, and the entire audit catalog is not covered.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-018 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-018: staff login email uniqueness and lookup use the R16 syntax-valid (whitespace refused) Unicode-casefolded form without provider-specific rewriting
verdicts.why: The check covers ASCII case normalization, case-insensitive duplicate lookup, and preservation of dots and plus tags. It does not test Unicode casefolding, whitespace refusal, or general syntax validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-003 [witness: verification:credential_security_policy_client_portal]; INV-003 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-003: passwords, session tokens, viewer access tokens and service credentials are stored only in verification/hash form and never logged
verdicts.why: Password persistence is checked against plaintext storage, and returned account views are checked elsewhere for absence of password_hash. Session-token verification storage, viewer tokens, service credentials, and non-logging of all credential classes are not asserted.

verdicts.item:
- TXN-001: the staff identity unit-of-work check
  [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements:
TXN-001: no transaction is rolled back twice, rolled back after a commit,
  or left open.
quotes: assert self.open_count == 0, f"{label}: left {self.open_count} transaction(s) open"
verdicts.why: Every instrumented transaction must leave the open count at zero and must record exactly one commit or rollback event, detecting double closure, closure after commit, and transactions left open.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: entity_id canonical [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; entity_id canonical [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
Every audit record's `entity_id` equals the canonical string of the audited
  entity's id, or is absent when that entity has none.
verdicts.why: Audits passed to _one_audit with an entity_id are checked against its canonical UUID string. The check does not validate every audit record and does not assert that entity_id is absent for entities having no ID.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-014 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-014: a staff account authenticates only in active status; pending_verification cannot log in
verdicts.why: Pending and suspended accounts are explicitly refused, while an activated account successfully authenticates. Authentication is not tested after disabled status, so the full active-only rule is not established.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-004 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-004: authentication flows never reveal account or viewer existence; auth failures never expose project data
verdicts.why: Wrong-password and unknown-address attempts produce the same rejection type, and the pending-account failure audit omits its reason code. The check does not assert that authentication failures cannot expose project data or comprehensively compare all externally visible failure information.
